esha: noticed our snapshot-mirroring job wrote several snapshots to cold-archive with SSE set to AES256 instead of CMEK. compliance dashboard flagged it.
tom: which principal performed the writes? esha: mirror-sa@prod-project via impersonation from orchestrator@tools-project. audit log: protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "orchestrator@tools-project", actingAs: "mirror-sa@prod-project"; request.cmekKey: null; resourceName: "projects/_/buckets/cold-archive/objects/snap-prod-2026-04-01". reeva: ohhh cross-project impersonation + grant scoping issue. we grant orchestrator the ability to impersonate mirror-sa but didn't ensure kms:Encrypt is allowed when impersonated.
infra-bot: terraform apply detected changes in iam/impersonation at 1745555400: +roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator for orchestrator on serviceAccount:mirror-sa@prod-project
tom: so orchestrator could get a short-lived token for mirror-sa but mirror-sa's KMS grants are bounded to project principals only. result: upload attempt didn't include CMK because the client failed kms:Encrypt and fell back to SSE-S3.
esha: immediate mitigation: revoke impersonation binding, or add explicit kms:Encrypt grant on CMK for the impersonated principal namespace. which is safer short-term? reeva: revoke impersonation first to stop more writes. then create a scoped grant that allows kms:Encrypt only for the mirror pipeline and with a TTL and audit bindings.
ops-bot: mitigation action started: revoking iam binding at 1745555620. will post status when done.
tom: we should also scan for objects in cold-archive without cmek tag and mark snapshots as potentially non-compliant and schedule re-wrap. query suggestion (GCP logs): SELECT protoPayload.resourceName, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp FROM `logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity` WHERE protoPayload.methodName = "storage.objects.insert" AND json_extract_scalar(protoPayload.request, '$.cmekKey') IS NULL AND protoPayload.resourceName LIKE "%cold-archive%" AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
reeva: long-term: policy: org-level constraint to require CMEK on buckets matching cold-archive pattern. also require that any SA impersonation flow includes kms:Encrypt in the impersonation scope or prohibit cross-project impersonation for storage writes.
esha: another gotcha: our snapshot-mirroring client composes SignedURLs for uploads in some paths which bypasses SSE headers if not set at pre-signed time. need to ensure pre-signed URLs include x-amz-server-side-encryption or GCS equivalent metadata.
security-bot: automated suggestion: add monitor on KMS GrantCreate/GrantRevoke events and alert if any active grant TTL < 24h for critical backup principals.
auditor: please capture object keys, sizes, timestamps, and the acting principal for compliance evidence. file ticket with these artifacts.
ops-bot: scan started at 1745555700; found 6 objects in last 7 days without cmek; tagging them in INC-2026-315.
reesa: typo: reeva here. I'll own the remediation: schedule re-encrypt copy jobs, update runbook section "cross-project impersonation and KMS", and add a CI terraform lint rule to prevent granting broad impersonation without kms scope.
esha: thanks. once re-encrypt done, we'll validate via asset inventory and close INC-2026-315. security-bot: reminder to add post-incident runbook updates within 72h. tom: quick PR to restrict impersonation lands shortly. closing loop in slack once remediation verified. :white_check_mark:
